verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is an API-first platform, so it runs headlessly by design. Requests authenticate non-interactively with API keys over HTTP Basic Auth, the docs explicitly describe testing from the command line, and a Developer Sandbox lets automation run safely away from production data. Core banking operations (account opening, ACH, wires, cards) and webhook registration are all exposed through the API, so pipelines can drive them end to end. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD guidance or examples, a first-party CLI or SDK, a published OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
